scripts.test:site: npm --prefix site run test:truth && npm --prefix site run lint && npm --prefix site run build

scripts.test:firm:browser: npm run build --workspace ui -- --configLoader runner && node --test test/browser/firm-journey.mjs
scripts.test:firm:acceptance-browser: npm run build --workspace ui -- --configLoader runner && node --test --test-concurrency=1 --test-force-exit test/browser/firm-journey.mjs test/browser/return-journey.mjs test/browser/dense-journey.mjs test/browser/wall-journey.mjs test/browser/native-coding-journey.mjs test/browser/workspace-modes-journey.mjs test/browser/model-view-journey.mjs test/browser/outward-action-journey.mjs
